### Added
- `llmRouting` (default `enabled: false`) in both charts: agent inference traffic through the installation's agentgateway, so the data plane emits GenAI metrics — tokens by type, cost in USD, request duration, time to first token — for every model call. **An installation that sets nothing renders byte-identically** (the golden check pins this). When on, the connectivity chart renders an `llm` listener on the data-plane Gateway (`llmRouting.listener`, default port 8081), an `AgentgatewayBackend` for the provider, an `HTTPRoute` pinned to that listener by `sectionName` and matching the provider path prefixes (`llmRouting.pathPrefixes`, default `/v1`) so it outranks the `agent-platform-mcps` catch-all route, which attaches to every listener of the same Gateway and wins an equal match, one Gateway-scoped `AgentgatewayPolicy` carrying the route-type map (`llmRouting.routes`) and the agent attribution labels (`llmRouting.metricLabels`), and the model-price ConfigMap (`llmRouting.modelCatalog`) that the Gateway's `AgentgatewayParameters` references. The gateway holds no provider credential: agent pods keep their own key and the client `x-api-key` header passes through, so reach to the listener grants no spend. Turning the listener on routes nothing by itself — the cutover is a second value, `kagent.providers.anthropic.config.baseUrl`, and rollback is its removal. The render fails when `llmRouting.enabled` is true without the agentgateway data plane, when the listener port collides with an existing one, or when `llmRouting.pathPrefixes` is empty or contains a bare `/`. See the connectivity chart README for the rollout.
- A `PodMonitor` for the agentgateway data plane, gated on the agentgateway component and the shared metrics helper — not on `llmRouting.enabled`, so the MCP path is scraped too and the monitor exists before an LLM cutover. The data plane serves Prometheus text on pod port 15020; the controller-provisioned Service exposes listener ports only, so a ServiceMonitor would match nothing. It carries the same tenant label as the kagent ServiceMonitor, which alloy-metrics discovers monitors by.
- `kagent.modelConfigs[].baseUrl` (optional): sends a chart-owned ModelConfig's traffic through the LLM listener. Without it an extra ModelConfig calls the provider directly and its usage is unmetered.
